events: BadgeIssued(address indexed owner, uint256 indexed badge_id, bytes public_key, string origin_network)
VerificationRequested(address indexed wallet, bytes public_key, string nonce, uint64 expires)
WalletVerified(address indexed wallet, uint256 indexed badge_id, bytes public_key, uint256 verified_at)

note: Both contracts are Arbitrum Stylus programs (Rust -> WASM). The constructor path of cargo-stylus >= 0.9 deploys, activates and runs the constructor atomically through the on-chain StylusDeployer (0xcEcba2F1...F8D03A990), so the deployment tx IS the activation tx; there is no separate activation hash. Two earlier pairs are dead and must not be used: pair A (registry 0x2862cbdc..., verifier 0x39db2d89...) and pair B (registry 0x4aa6737f..., verifier 0x1bc7b44e...) - both have owner == 0x0 because their constructors never ran, which makes set_issuer impossible on them. IMPORTANT: stylus-sdk 0.10.9 exports Vec<u8> parameters as uint8[] (NOT bytes), so the client ABI must declare verifyAndIssue(uint8[],string,uint64,uint8[],string) (selector 0xe5f28691) and issue(address,uint8[],string) (selector 0x4a7d65c1). Run `node scripts/chain-admin.mjs set-issuer <registry> <verifier>` only when the verifier changes. Publish Rust source with `cargo stylus verify` in each crate.
